meta.disclaimer: NLEM 2022, the PMBJP generic annexure of 31 December 2025, and public company composition tables retrieved 27 October 2026. A price is stored only when the source printed an MRP. This is not the Indian 60,000-brand or 3,000-company market. Disease tags are inferred unless origin is section.

byCompany.note: Generic product list only. Foracort, Seroflo, and the rest of the branded portfolio are not on this page.

zydusNotLoaded.reason: Zydus Lifesciences' India formulations table prints brand, SKU, and a strength that is a dose (for example 20 MG), not the ingredient. Those rows were not loaded. Export tables that do name a generic were not copied onto the India brands. Zydus and Glenmark GST MRP lists have no composition column, so no price was invented.

checkedButNotLoaded: Dr. Reddy's September 2026 finished-formulations PDF is a generic-name list (abiraterone tablets, and so on), not India brands. No brand was invented.
Lupin's public product finder is a search page. The HTML retrieved on 2026-10-27 did not contain a composition table.
Glenmark's GST 2.0 PDF prints pack and MRP and does not print composition. Those prices were not given an invented ingredient.
Abbott's A–Z index is one page per product, not a composition table. It was not row-counted.
Macleods' public home page did not expose a composition table in this pass.
Zydus India formulations: strength is a dose, not an ingredient. See zydusNotLoaded.
NPPA Pharma Sahi Daam, IPDMS, MIMS/CIMS, and retail pharmacies were not scraped.
